newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Abecafe seeks Europe coffee contract change.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Abecafe seeks Europe coffee contract change.

text.p: Brazil's Coffee Exporters' Association (Abecafe) would like to see the standard contract used for coffee sales to Europe changed to include the weight of containers before they are loaded at Brazilian ports.
The aim of the change would be to avoid exporters' being held responsible for any possible losses in weight after loading, Abecafe said in a statement.
Abecafe has recently sent a letter to the European Coffee Federation which is responsible for drawing up the terms of the contract, Abecafe president Jorge Esteve said.
Currently shippers refuse to accept responsibility for any loss in weight when the cargo arrives at its destination as they say they receive the containers already loaded.
One recent example highlighting the exporters' concerns involved a container which was damaged onboard ship. The cargo was transferred to another container without any independent supervision.
On arrival, a loss in weight was discovered and under the terms of the current contract, the exporter was forced to pay the difference to the buyer, Abecafe said.
